title: What happens if you do not brush your teeth for a year – level 1
paragraphs: Brushing your teeth every day keeps your mouth healthy. If you stop cleaning your mouth, bad bacteria grow very fast. In a few days, your gums start to bleed and hurt.

After a month, the bugs make holes in your teeth. We call these holes cavities. If you go a full year without brushing, your teeth can fall out. Also, the bacteria can get into your blood and make your heart, brain, and body sick.
Brushing two times a day keeps your mouth clean, saves your teeth, and helps your body stay strong and happy.
